page.content:
Giger's perfect organism — acid blood, inner jaw, hive logic.

How Xenomorph connects

  • Character: H. R. Giger — H. R. Giger designed the xenomorph.
  • Work: Alien (1979) — The 1979 film introduces the xenomorph aboard the Nostromo.
  • Character: Ellen Ripley — Ripley survives and later hunts the xenomorph.
  • Concept: Facehugger — The facehugger is the implanting stage of the xenomorph cycle.
  • Concept: Chestburster — The chestburster is the xenomorph's birth from a host.
  • Character: Xenomorph Queen — The Queen lays the eggs that grow a hive.
  • Location: LV-426 — The derelict and later hive are on LV-426.
  • Faction: Weyland-Yutani — The Company wants the xenomorph as a biological weapon.
  • Character: David — David's Covenant experiments refine creatures toward the xenomorph.

What is Xenomorph?

The xenomorph is the parasitic alien whose egg–facehugger–chestburster life cycle and biomechanical body define the franchise's terror.

Key threads lead to H. R. Giger, Alien (1979), Ellen Ripley, Facehugger, Chestburster and Xenomorph Queen.
